name: Kayamori Rino
source:
Student Council Vice President

A classmate of the protagonist. She's gentle, kind, and mild mannered. 

She's a very diligent girl, and is the top honor student in her class. Doesn't have much self-assertion, so she's good at untiringly doing favors for others. 

Quite shy, so she's a woman of few words. Her class teacher and friends pushed her to run for student council vice presidency.

To change her introverted personality even by a little, she endeavors herself in her student council work. 

She likes cooking, so she often makes sweets and brings them to the student council room. 

[Translated from [url=http://voguish.x.fc2.com/html/sgh.html]Official Site[/url]]
